title: Butternut squash mac and cheese
summary: Creamy mac and cheese with hidden butternut squash and less cheese than the boxed kind.
texture: Soft, small pasta shapes in a smooth sauce. Cook the pasta until very soft.
steps: Steam or boil the squash for 12 to 15 minutes until very soft.
Cook the pasta in unsalted water until soft, then drain.
Blend the squash with the milk until smooth, then warm it in the pasta pot with the butter.
Stir in the cheese until melted, then add the pasta. Cool before serving.
choking: Use small pasta shapes and cook them soft.
Let it cool and stir well: melted cheese can stay very hot in the middle.

allergens.name: Wheat
allergens.note: Regular macaroni is made from wheat.

allergens.name: Milk
allergens.note: Contains milk, cheese and butter. Whole cow's milk is fine in food and as a drink from 12 months.

storage: Fridge up to 3 days. Reheat with a splash of milk, stirring well, and check the temperature.
tips: Swap squash for sweet potato or cauliflower.
Cheese is salty, so a little goes a long way for toddlers.
